name: Folder Shelf
author: samara-hub-ro
description: A glass shelf on your desktop holding the folders you actually use: hover one to see inside it — thumbnails, recent files, size, composition and permissions — and open it in your file manager with a double click.

barWidget.description: Show or hide the desktop shelf, and lift it above your windows while you use it.

schema.label: Layout
schema.description: Grid puts the folders in tiles with the name underneath. List gives each folder a row with its headline numbers already on it.

schema.label: Tile size (px)
schema.description: Size of a folder tile in grid layout. The shelf fits as many columns as its width allows.

schema.label: Show folder names
schema.description: Print the name under each tile. Turn it off for an icon-only shelf; the name still appears in the preview.

schema.label: Background opacity (%)
schema.description: Opacity of the shelf's glass. Pair it with the Hyprland blur layerrule from the README for a frosted surface rather than a flat wash.

schema.label: Preview on hover
schema.description: Open the preview card when the pointer rests on a folder. With this off, the shelf is a plain launcher.

schema.label: Preview delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer has to sit on a folder before its preview opens. Raise it if previews appear while you are passing through.

schema.label: Thumbnails
schema.description: How many image thumbnails the preview shows for a folder that has pictures in it.

schema.label: Recent entries
schema.description: How many of the folder's most recently changed entries the preview lists.

schema.label: Read the whole tree
schema.description: Walk the folder recursively for total size, total file count and the type breakdown. Turn it off to read only the top level, which is instant on very large folders.

schema.label: Scan timeout (s)
schema.description: How long a recursive walk may run before the preview settles for what it managed to read. Results are cached, so a slow folder is slow once.

schema.label: Show on every monitor
schema.description: Put the same shelf on all your screens instead of only the one it was left on. Each screen keeps its own hover previews and menus, and moving or resizing the shelf on any of them moves it on all of them.

schema.label: Lock in place
schema.description: Stop the shelf being moved or resized by dragging, once you have it where you want it.

schema.label: Fill the shelf on first use
schema.description: The first time the shelf opens empty, add the XDG folders you actually have — Downloads, Documents, Pictures and the rest.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Glyph shown in the bar. Leave it empty for the drawn shelf mark, or put any character your bar font carries here.

schema.label: Shelf file
schema.description: Where the shelf's folders and its position are stored. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/folder-shelf.json.
